purpose: Provenance of the three kurmanci-bench reports in this directory. The reports themselves record only pack path, byte count, entry count, build profile and 'host: macos aarch64'; everything below was recorded separately at measurement time and is not taken from the reports.
source_commit_note: main after #71; the bench binary and the packs were built from this commit's tree (working tree also held untracked files that do not enter the build: android/kurmanci/src/main/jniLibs/ and keyboard-inspect.sh)

toolchain.allocator: kurmanci-bench counting global allocator (adds a small constant cost to every allocation; engine_heap_bytes is its live-heap delta after load)

command: cargo run --release -p kurmanci-bench -- data/build/packs/<pack>/lexicon.bin --json   (defaults: --iterations 500, --loads 5, --probe-words ez li di ji ku bo bi; the report's 'reloads: 4' are the loads after the first)
